. Alles wat over leerlingen gaat, blijft: . Everything about students stays on this PC: there is no account, no cloud and no company watching. Students go over the classroom network to this PC; their answers go nowhere else.
De gegevens staan in deze map:: The data is in this folder:
voornamen (of wat je zelf intypt), het l: first names (or whatever you type yourself), the grade and per student the level (Page, Squire, Knight), also per subject.
per leerling welke vraag goed of fout wa: per student which question was right or wrong, for which curriculum goal, how sure the student was and whether they guessed. One file per school year.
na elk spel een Excel-bestand met de sco: after every game an Excel file with the scores.
het zorgoverzicht wordt berekend uit het: the support overview is calculated from the logbook. Notes you type yourself are in the class list folder.
hoe een leerling zijn ridder aankleedde: how a student dressed their knight and their attempts in the word game, with their name.
wat een leerling op het Klaseiland bouwd: what a student built on Class Island, the name of their castle and the Honour the teacher gave (with the reason). The rest of the Honour is calculated from the logbook.
foto's die je zelf toevoegt voor in de a: photos you add yourself for the arena.
Leerlingtoestellen bewaren alleen een wi: Student devices only keep a random player code, the chosen name, their knight and small preferences (like sound on or off) in the browser, to keep playing after a reload.
Wat gaat er wél naar internet?: What does go to the internet?
Making quizzes and worksheets with AI.
Het onderwerp, je extra wensen en de les: The topic, your extra wishes and the lesson material you add (screenshot, PDF) go to the AI you chose in Settings (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude or OpenAI ChatGPT), or to the chatbot where you paste the prompt yourself. Names or results of students don't go along. So don't add lesson material with students' names on it.
(als je die koppelt): je quizzen, oefenb: (if you link it): your quizzes, worksheets, Round Tables, tasks, the words of the week from The Rune Riddle and your textbooks from My textbooks go to your OneDrive or Google Drive, and from the class list only the names and levels (to set tasks per student at home). Also a copy of the Class Island: the castles and per student the Honour, rank and shields, to view at home. The logbook, the results, notes and the students' work never.
LANcelot vraagt aan GitHub of er een nie: LANcelot asks GitHub whether there is a new version, only when you press the button.
gebruikt de stem van de browser. Sommige: uses the browser's voice. Some browser voices work online; then the text of the worksheet being read goes to the maker of the browser, never anything about the student.
Gebruik geen achternamen of andere gegev: Don't use surnames or other data you don't need.
als je wegloopt: wie op deze pc zit, kan: when you walk away: whoever sits at this PC can open the teacher screen. Student devices can't open the teacher screen, the logbook or the results.
(Instellingen) bevatten alle gegevens va: (Settings) contain all the class's data. Keep them in a safe place, e.g. a USB stick you don't leave lying around.
maak een back-up als de school dat wil,: make a backup if the school wants that, and then delete the class list, the logbook and the results in the data folder. Parents and students may ask what is stored about them; you find all of it in that folder.
De school is verantwoordelijk voor leerl: The school is responsible for student data (GDPR). Let the head teacher or the data protection officer know that you use LANcelot and what is stored. You may use this page for that.
Deze uitleg beschrijft hoe LANcelot werk: This explanation describes how LANcelot works. It is not legal advice.
